reviewNotes: Expected gates/quotas are explicit 2024 class features. Legacy expectations document the narrower historical740-line interpreter, not a correctness standard.
Full actual options and ownership repair cases are tested separately; no private characters are loaded.

2026-10-26 official PHB errata: Flaming Sphere is Evocation. Explicit Savant membership updated only for Evoker and excluded other supported schools. Source: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/sae/players-handbook . No Conjurer subclass exists in this supported catalog.

2026-10-26 primary Standard/Rare language table includes Druidic and Thieves' Cant. Additional class-language options now include those two, exclude universal Common, and retain source-aware already-known exclusions. Only Ranger/Rogue language membership/array expectations and their explicit legacy-parity exclusions changed; other option arrays and quotas were not regenerated. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/creating-a-character#ChooseLanguages
